outputs.content:
SERVICE AGREEMENT

This Service Agreement is made between the Provider and the Client named in Schedule 1.

1. SERVICES
The Provider will perform rooftop solar panel cleaning and gutter care at the Client's premises as described in Schedule 1, using its own equipment and personnel.

2. FEES AND PAYMENT
The Client will pay the fees set out in Schedule 1 within 7 days of the invoice date. Fees are exclusive of GST unless stated otherwise.

3. ACCESS AND SAFETY
The Client will provide safe access to the roof and any required switchboard isolation. The Provider may refuse to work where access cannot be made safe.

4. LIABILITY
The Provider maintains public liability insurance. Liability is limited to the resupply of the services or the cost of resupply, to the extent permitted by law.

5. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate on 14 days written notice. Fees for services performed before termination remain payable.
